svg.title: Concentrix – Utility Bills Automation
svg.desc: Flow diagram: invoice sources, AI processing, data enrichment and user experience.

text.tspan: Power Automate cloud flows retrieve invoices from multiple
sources, AI prompts and AI Builder custom models extract
data from OCR-processed or raw PDF files.
Power Automate cloud flows validate, clean,
and enrich the data using Dataverse reference
tables before saving it to SQL Server.
